note: Fixes a display fault in v0.122: the greyed-out number in a blank Temperature field read about -258 C, because the placeholder dropped the 273.15 between the field's Celsius and the kelvin its formatter expects. Your flights were not affected by the display itself - the simulation was handed the right value throughout - but it was reachable, because the spinner arrows seed from that number and could commit -60 C on a blank field. If you pressed the arrows on a blank Temperature field in v0.122, check that field.
